name: Beach Clean-up
description: Join the community to remove plastics and keep Port Phillip Bay clean.

name: Shell & Fish Count Walk
description: Join a guided walk to record the number of shells or small fish you see along the shore.

name: Poster-Making for Schools
description: Create colorful “Protect the Bay” posters to share in your classroom.

name: Seashell Art Workshop
description: Collect clean seashells and turn them into creative art pieces that remind everyone to protect the bay.

name: Garden Treasure Hunt
description: Explore plants and join a fun treasure hunt while learning how gardens help the ocean.

name: Mangrove Protection Walk
description: Discover mangroves and help clean rubbish to protect the shoreline and sea creatures.

name: Bird-Watching Day
description: Spot swans and ducks while learning how wetlands keep our bay clean.

name: Coastal Tree Planting
description: Plant native trees and shrubs to stop erosion and create safe habitats for animals.

name: Seagrass Discovery Snorkel
description: Try snorkeling to see seagrass meadows and the fish that live in them.

name: Beach Safety Patrol
description: Learn from lifeguards about beach safety and why clean water matters.

name: Rock Pool Explorer
description: Search for crabs, starfish, and sea snails in shallow rock pools with your family.

name: Paddle-Board Fun
description: Try paddle boarding safely while spotting seabirds and dolphins.

name: Marine Life Drawing
description: Draw dolphins, turtles, and penguins while learning ocean fun facts.

name: Beach Theatre
description: Watch kid-friendly plays about marine life and protecting the bay.

name: Penguin & Bathing Box Adventure
description: Visit Brighton’s colorful bathing boxes and see penguins at St Kilda at sunset.
